gold_sql:
SELECT
  p.*,
  ST_Distance(
    ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.21808 42.606947)',4326)::geography,
    p.geometry::geography
  ) AS distance,
  elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(
        p.geometry::geography,
        ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.21808 42.606947)',4326)::geography,
        4200
      )
  AND leisure = 'park';

WITH hospital_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-71.21808, 42.606947), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
park_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-78.657985, 43.204052), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
distance_check AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Distance(hospital_point.geom, park_point.geom) AS distance_meters
  FROM hospital_point, park_point
),
elevation_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(r.rast, ST_Transform(park_point.geom, 4326)::geometry) AS elevation
  FROM public.dem_us r, park_point
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, ST_Transform(park_point.geom, 4326)::geometry)
)
SELECT 
  dc.distance_meters,
  ea.elevation
FROM distance_check dc, elevation_analysis ea;
